page.content:
Shubert house on 44th Street, long home of A Chorus Line and later hits.

How Shubert Theatre connects

  • Faction: The Shubert Organization — The Shubert Organization owns the Shubert Theatre.
  • Location: Broadway theatre district — The Shubert Theatre sits on 44th Street in the theatre district.
  • Work: A Chorus Line — A Chorus Line's original Broadway run was at the Shubert Theatre.

What is Shubert Theatre?

The Shubert Theatre is the flagship Shubert house on West 44th Street, the stage that housed A Chorus Line's original run and still sits at the geographic center of Shubert Alley.

Key threads lead to The Shubert Organization, Broadway theatre district and A Chorus Line.
